posts.body:
Hi

Am looking at getting a snugglebundl (blanket thing with handles to make lifting baby easier). They only seem available at a couple of retailers and doesn't look like I can get it under the rrp of £40. Has anyone else been looking at these things and noticed if there are ever any offers on them? Thanks in advance.

posts.body:
I have one of these for my baby (due November). The only place I found it cheaper was at a baby show at Bluewater earlier this year. There is another one running in October - and the same company run one up North too. Might be worth it if there is a fair amount of other stuff you need as you tend to get some pretty good deals (we got a great deal on our pram and carry cot too). I'd check snugglebundl are going again though!

You can usually pick up cheap tickets to these events - or check out the competitions forum on here as I won my tickets last time around...

posts.body: This is on my list for my second baby due in November as I have a bad back. I have been looking on ebay but they go for silly money. I emailed Snugglebundl on FB enquiring about colours (I noticed their website only offers the spotted one but ebay seemed to have lots of colours) they sent me a really lovely reply and a 10% off code so I will probably just order from them. Not a massive saving but it helps! I think the baby show is too far from me to travel to. I am not sure if its a generic code or what but I can let you know it too if you like x
